payload.speaker: tuber_0
payload.text: The wrought-iron gates of Leto Manor swing open without a sound. A stone path leads to a grand entrance hall. Marble floors gleam under gaslight. You see three strangers already waiting inside: a woman with bright eyes, a tall elf with sharp ears, and a man grinning too wide. The air smells of beeswax and old paper. The heavy invitation card in your hand pulses faintly warm. Leena nods at you, then turns to Vigil. Bob taps his foot against the marble. All four of you feel it—a pull toward the same empty space between you. The silence stretches too long. What are you waiting for?
